html:
The founder of the Asante Empire, who united Akan states around Kumasi about 1701 and ruled as its first Asantehene until his death in 1717.

With the priest Okomfo Anokye he gave the union a sacred centre, the Golden Stool, and a constitution of loyal chiefs. Their army defeated the overlord Denkyira at the Battle of Feyiase in 1701, opening the way to the coast. Asante went on to rule most of what is now Ghana, trading gold, kola and captives. Osei Tutu died fighting the Akyem. The Asantehene still reigns in Kumasi.
sum: The founder of the Asante Empire, who united Akan states around Kumasi about 1701 and ruled as its first Asantehene until his death in 1717.
